label: P2RY8::CRLF2

sections.text: P2RY8 encodes a G-protein-coupled receptor involved in lymphocyte localization.
CRLF2 encodes a receptor subunit that pairs with IL7R to mediate thymic stromal lymphopoietin signaling.

A pseudoautosomal-region deletion joins the P2RY8 promoter to CRLF2 coding sequences, increasing CRLF2 expression. It is a promoter-substitution event that can cooperate with JAK-pathway alterations in B-ALL.
